messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up: want to run a small pilot called 'Sprout Shout' next Wed at lunch. Micro-spot awards in Slack + optional printed note cards for folks at desks. Low friction. Volunteers?
Samir: Sounds fun. What's the minimum viable flow?
Maya: Slash command only: /shout give @handle <badge> <1-line why>. Badge choices only, short reasons optional. No new accounts.
Jess: I can wire the slash command and post events. Will add throttles (3/min, 8/day).
Samir: Make sure analytics are team-aggregated and strip free-text from metrics.
Jess: Will send events with badge ID, giver team, and timestamp. Free-text kept only in message body, not in analytics.
Katie: Ill write the launch blurb and a one-pager. Proposed badges: "Goes the Extra Mile", "Team Builder", "Quick Fix", "Explainer", "Made My Day".
Nora: For physical notes: estimate 150 cards. Ops-bot, can you make an address capture link?
Ops-bot: Done: https://forms.redwood/sprout-shout-cards fields: giver, recipient, desk address. Closes 5 days after launch.
Dana: Budget? Printer quote? I can help with fulfillment.
Nora: Quote ~ $190 for 150 double-sided cards including postage. Will need a PO.
Maya: I'll request the small expense and loop finance.
Samir: Moderation during lunch to handle questions/spam?
Katie: I can be on watch 11:30-12:30 PT.
Jess: Plan: deploy to staging Tue EOD; prod Wed morning. I'll share sample usages.
Maya: Let's do a 15-min sync Fri 9:30 PT to finalize copy, badge blurbs, and PO. Who can join?
Katie: In.
Jess: In.
Nora: In.
Dana: In.
Maya: Thanks all  I'll drop the draft one-pager by Thu and send the invite. :seedling:
